tagline: Your changelog, written by AI, in plain language your customers actually understand.

versions.summary: The biggest release yet — AI-written release notes, a self-promoting widget, and GitHub/GitLab support.

Features.title: AI-written release notes
Features.body: Changelog Agent now reads your git commits and writes plain-language, customer-facing release notes for you. No more shipping with a skipped changelog — every change is explained in words your users actually understand.

Features.title: Self-promoting changelog widget
Features.body: Embed a single HTML file on your site and your changelog renders beautifully — with a small 'Made with Changelog Agent' badge that markets the product to every visitor. Your changelog is now your best billboard.

Features.title: GitHub and GitLab support
Features.body: Connect a repository via API token and pull merged pull requests directly. Works with your existing workflow — no webhooks, no extra infrastructure.

Fixes.title: Fixed duplicate commit grouping
Fixes.body: Squashed and duplicate commits are now merged into a single logical change instead of appearing as separate, confusing entries.

Fixes.title: Fixed empty-repo crash
Fixes.body: Running the tool on a repository with no commits no longer crashes — it now shows a clear, helpful message instead.

Improvements.title: Faster local processing
Improvements.body: Grouping and writing now run up to 40% faster on local hardware, so you get your changelog without waiting around.

Improvements.title: Cleaner Markdown output
Improvements.body: The generated CHANGELOG.md now follows Keep-a-Changelog conventions more closely, making it easier to read and diff.

versions.summary: Smarter grouping and a human review gate so nothing ships without a second pair of eyes.

Features.title: Human review gate
Features.body: Drafts are now written to a review folder before anything is published. A human reviews and approves each changelog, so AI-slop never reaches your customers.

Fixes.title: Fixed incorrect category bucketing
Fixes.body: Commits with unconventional prefixes are now classified more accurately instead of being dumped into the wrong section.

Improvements.title: Better commit merging
Improvements.body: Related commits like 'fix login' and 'fix login redirect' are now recognized as one change and merged into a single, coherent entry.

versions.summary: The first public release — read commits, group them, and produce a clean changelog.

Features.title: Read commits from any local repo
Features.body: Point Changelog Agent at any git repository and it reads your commit history, ready to turn it into a changelog.

Features.title: Group changes into sections
Features.body: Commits are automatically grouped into Features, Fixes, and Improvements so your changelog is organized and scannable.

Improvements.title: Plain-language output
Improvements.body: Release notes are written for your customers, not your engineers — no jargon, no internal ticket numbers, no 'refactored X'.
